query: Set up a two-tier treasury for our company with a hot wallet for daily payments and a cold wallet with multi-sig for reserves
expected_behavior: Creates operator users with treasury-admin and treasury-operator tags
Creates two wallets: treasury-hot and treasury-cold
Tags wallet private keys as hot-wallet and cold-storage
Creates ALLOW policy for hot wallet with single-signer consensus
Creates ALLOW policy for cold wallet with 2-of-3 multi-sig consensus
Creates DENY policy for hot wallet spending limits
Creates DENY policy for cold wallet address allowlist
Verifies hot wallet signs immediately and cold wallet triggers CONSENSUS_NEEDED

expected_behavior: Checks hot wallet balance using get_balances
Uses sign_transaction with the hot wallet address as signWith
Sets transaction type to TRANSACTION_TYPE_ETHEREUM
Monitors activity status until COMPLETED

expected_behavior: Signs the transaction with cold wallet address, expects CONSENSUS_NEEDED status
Explains that the activity fingerprint is needed for approval

Second admin calls approve_activity with the fingerprint
After quorum is met, the original activity moves to COMPLETED

expected_behavior: Retrieves the current allowlist policy using get_policy
Updates the policy condition to include the new address in the in[] list

Preserves existing approved addresses while adding the new one

expected_behavior: Lists activities filtered by FAILED status to find denied transactions
Uses get_policy_evaluations for denied activities to identify which policy blocked them
Lists users to verify correct tag assignments (treasury-admin, treasury-operator)

expected_behavior: Creates the user with treasury-operator tag using create_users
